data.content:
I drafted and sent two of the three disputes, and held back the third because it has no evidence. Both sent disputes went out through `send_dispute`, which returned ok for each. I didn't see an approval prompt, so please confirm you approved them. Next deadline: **2026-12-12** (28 days). My notes are in `/plan.md`.

**Sent**
- **UE-9a47 ($11.80, 85% win probability):** The order ticket lists only "Protein Bowl", and the claimed "Fruit Bowl" isn't on it. The order was ready at 18:20 and picked up at 18:22. The ticket shows what was prepared, not what was packed, so the dispute says nothing about the bag contents.
- **UE-9a31 ($24.30, 65%, up from 55%):** The order was ready at 12:28 and picked up at 12:33. The ticket lists the Honey Drizzle, which doesn't help the case. It shows the item was ordered, not that it was packed. The dispute cites only the pickup record.

**Held back**
- **UE-9b02 ($33.00, 30%, down from 55%):** This is the largest deduction, but there is no order ticket on file, so the claimed Green Smoothie can't be checked. I haven't drafted a dispute.
- **What I need from you:** a photo of the ticket for order UE-9b02. If you send it, I'll re-check the case.

**Lessons from past disputes:** None applied. My memory only has DoorDash lessons, and there were no similar Uber Eats cases to recall, so I haven't cited any.

**Expected recovery:** about $25.83 across the two sent cases (65% of $24.30 plus 85% of $11.80). That doesn't count UE-9b02.

When you hear back from Uber Eats on either dispute, tell me and I'll record the outcome.
